description: Implementation of the DrmManagerClient class for managing DRM operations in Android, including methods for rights management, decryption sessions, and metadata handling.

classes.name: DrmManagerClient
classes.description: A client interface for managing DRM rights, decryption, and metadata operations in Android.

methods.name: DrmManagerClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DRM client and registering it.

methods.name: ~DrmManagerClient
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up DRM client registration.

methods.name: setOnInfoListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for DRM info events.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Retrieves DRM constraints for a given content path and action.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves DRM metadata for a given content path.

methods.name: canHandle
methods.description: Checks if the DRM client can handle a specific content path and MIME type.

methods.name: processDrmInfo
methods.description: Processes DRM information.

methods.name: acquireDrmInfo
methods.description: Acquires DRM information based on a request.

methods.name: saveRights
methods.description: Saves DRM rights to specified paths.

methods.name: getOriginalMimeType
methods.description: Gets the original MIME type of a DRM content.

methods.name: getDrmObjectType
methods.description: Gets the DRM object type for a content path and MIME type.

methods.name: checkRightsStatus
methods.description: Checks the rights status for a content path and action.

methods.name: consumeRights
methods.description: Consumes rights for a decryption handle.

methods.name: setPlaybackStatus
methods.description: Sets playback status for a decryption handle.

methods.name: validateAction
methods.description: Validates an action on a DRM content.

methods.name: removeRights
methods.description: Removes rights for a specific content path.

methods.name: removeAllRights
methods.description: Removes all DRM rights.

methods.name: openConvertSession
methods.description: Opens a DRM conversion session for a MIME type.

methods.name: convertData
methods.description: Converts DRM data within a session.

methods.name: closeConvertSession
methods.description: Closes a DRM conversion session.

methods.name: getAllSupportInfo
methods.description: Retrieves all supported DRM info.

methods.name: openDecryptSession
methods.description: Opens a DRM decryption session with various overloads.

methods.name: closeDecryptSession
methods.description: Closes a DRM decryption session.

methods.name: initializeDecryptUnit
methods.description: Initializes a decrypt unit for a handle.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption on data.

methods.name: finalizeDecryptUnit
methods.description: Finalizes a decrypt unit.

methods.name: pread
methods.description: Reads decrypted data at a specific offset.
